<mxCell id="flow-header" value="<b>ShopCore — Transactional Checkout &amp; Inventory Locking Flow</b><br>End-to-End Sequence • Zero-Trust Price Recomputation • Pessimistic Inventory Lock • Webhook Reconciliation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;fontColor=#FFFFFF;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="30" width="1060" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="step1" value="<b>1. Submit Cart &amp; Key</b><br>Client sends cart items + Idempotency-Key" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step2" value="<b>2. Auth &amp; Rate Limit</b><br>Verify session JWT, check rate limit" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="315" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step3" value="<b>3. Price Recomputation</b><br>Recalculate all totals in integer cents from DB" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="590" y="125" width="230" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step4" value="<b>4. Idempotency Lock</b><br>Hash key, return cached or acquire lock" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="865" y="125" width="235" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step5" value="<b>5. Atomic Stock Lock</b><br>WHERE stock &gt;= qty (15-min TTL)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="865" y="285" width="235" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step6" value="<b>6. Stripe Session</b><br>Create Stripe hosted checkout session" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF1F2;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="590" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step7" value="<b>7. Pending Order</b><br>Status PENDING, commit DB transaction" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EEF2FF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontColor=#1E1B4B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="315" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step8" value="<b>8. Customer Pays</b><br>Browser redirects to Stripe, pays" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="285" width="230" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step9" value="<b>9. Webhook Ingest</b><br>checkout.session.completed with HMAC" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF1F2;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step10" value="<b>10. HMAC &amp; Dedup</b><br>Verify sig, check processed_events table" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="415" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="step11" value="<b>11. Order Commit</b><br>Status -&gt; PAID, reserve -&gt; COMMITTED" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="455" width="310" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: ShopCore — Transactional Checkout & Inventory Locking Flow
End-to-End Sequence • Zero-Trust Price Recomputation • Pessimistic Inventory Lock • Webhook Reconciliation
• Client sends cart item IDs & qty
• UPDATE products SET stock = stock - q
• Ingested via raw body buffer at /api/webhooks/stripe
• Insert audit_log record with event payload
CRITICAL FAILURE MODES & DISTRIBUTED RECOVERY STRATEGIES
• Two users attempt to buy last item simultaneously.
• SQL WHERE stock >= qty evaluates atomically.
• User reserves inventory but closes Stripe tab.
• Cleanup task restores stock to products table.
• Stripe re-sends webhook if ACK latency > 5s.
• State transitions and inventory remain untouched.
